steps.message: How many swimming activities did I do this week in the OpenTracks app? Assume the week starts from Monday. Express your answer as a single integer.
Execute: adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; ls /data/data | grep -i -E 'open|track' ; ls /data/user/0 | grep -i -E 'open|track'"
